stem:
Students observe some objects on a lab tray. The students will classify the objects based on physical properties common to all of the objects.

Based on their common properties, how should these objects be classified?

options.label: F
options.text:
Insulate thermal energy
Bendable
Attract to magnets

options.label: G
options.text:
Soluble in water
Attract to magnets
Conduct thermal energy

options.label: H
options.text:
Conduct electrical energy
Bendable
Soluble in water

options.label: J
options.text:
Conduct thermal energy
Conduct electrical energy
Not soluble in water
